params.body:
Since version 4 of the `/id` log went live on 5 October 2026 (key-1 moved onto a hardware token, abovebeyond-ai/abovebeyond#141), the evidence check has refused every pull request from the hands:

```
REFUSE the record's agent did:webvh:Qmb8L…:abovebeyond.ai:id#agent-workbench-shed is not under the DID did:web:abovebeyond.ai or its aliases, nor under a successor that carries its #key-1
```

The action resolves `https://abovebeyond.ai/.well-known/did.json` by default. That is the document of the first log, final at version 14, so its key-1 can never change. `relying` accepts the successor identity (`…:abovebeyond.ai:id`) only while it carries the same `#key-1`, and since version 4 it doesn't. The successor link was the old key-1, and that key moved.

The default is now the identity in force: `https://abovebeyond.ai/id/did.json`. It names the gateway's key, `#portal`, the operator keys and every agent, and lists both did:webvh identifiers as aliases. Records under either identifier therefore hold, with no successor rule needed.

## Checked with `relying` v0.20.1, the version this action pins, on real pull request bodies

| Pull request | `/.well-known/did.json` | `/id/did.json` |
|---|---|---|
| Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#292 (shed, 6 Oct) | REFUSE | holds |
| abovebeyond-ai/portal#336 (Elixir, 30 Sep) | REFUSE | holds |
| stocklistdealer-eu/platform#959 (shed, 5 Oct) | REFUSE | holds |
| Hoet-design/hoet-eyewear#70 (workbench, 28 Sep) | REFUSE | holds |

The same result with `relying` built from control's `main`.

## After merging (operator)

Every repository uses `@v1`, so the tag has to move to the merge commit:

```bash
cd ~/Projects/control-verify-action && git pull
git tag -f v1 && git push -f origin v1
```

Then re-run the failed `evidence` jobs (for example gentells-pipeline#292).

`relying`'s own `--did` default in control (`cmd/relying/main.go`) still names `/.well-known`. It matters only when relying is run by hand without `--did`; a follow-up in control.
params.title: Verify against the identity in force (/id/did.json)
